description: This file defines a React layout component called PublicLayout, which provides a structured page layout with navigation, main content area, and footer. It also includes a sub-component PublicTopNav to render a top navigation bar with links and authentication controls.

methods.name: PublicLayout
methods.description: Main layout component rendering the overall page structure with header, main content, and footer.

methods.description: Component rendering the top navigation bar with site title and links.
